description: The text of a range of pages of one insurance document, in page order, at most 50 pages per call: page (1-based) and text. Pass the document's SHA-256 exactly as the task gives it. Read a document by calling it from page 1 to its last page.

configuration.query: FROM bandit*-documents | WHERE document_hash == ?document_hash AND page >= ?from_page AND page <= ?to_page | KEEP page, text | SORT page | LIMIT 50

document_hash.description: The document's SHA-256, exactly as given in the task.

from_page.description: The first page to return, counting from 1.

to_page.description: The last page to return, for example the document's page count.
